headline: Metalfor Files for Creditor Protection to Continue Operations
summary: Agricultural machinery manufacturer Metalfor filed for creditor protection in Marcos Juárez, Córdoba, assuring it will continue production and service.
why: Distress filings by major equipment manufacturers highlight financing pressures in the agricultural sector and affect supply chains for farm machinery.

impacts.name: Metalfor
impacts.why: Filing for creditor protection indicates severe financial distress.
